feed.title: TC Passios: the site's future — Lunenburg Budget Project
feed.subtitle: What happens to the TC Passios site -- senior housing, a community centre, both, or demolition?

entry.title: Now following: TC Passios: the site's future
entry.summary: What happens to the TC Passios site -- senior housing, a community centre, both, or demolition?

entry.title: TC Passios: the site's future: Select Board, 2026-09-15
entry.summary: The board will not pursue a MassWorks grant to study senior housing at the former TCP school this grant cycle, saying more public discussion is needed first.

entry.title: TC Passios: the site's future: Lunenburg Municipal Building Design Committee, 2026-08-31
entry.summary: Committee agreed to ask the feasibility study to scope three options for the TC Pasios site: senior housing alone, senior housing plus a community center, and senior housing plus community center plus a town green.

entry.title: TC Passios: the site's future: Select Board, 2026-08-18
entry.summary: Old business: Lunenburg municipal buildings (Brooks House, TCP, Ritter tour discussion)

entry.title: TC Passios: the site's future: Select Board, 2026-08-11
entry.summary: TCP tour begins: food pantry cafeteria/kitchen area condition and roof leaks

entry.title: TC Passios: the site's future: Select Board, 2026-08-04
entry.summary: Facilities director Chris Ruth will continue developing separated cost estimates for TCP (needs vs. wants, roof, ADA triggers, systems) before the board decides on outside consultants.

entry.title: TC Passios: the site's future: Select Board, 2026-07-28
entry.summary: No formal vote taken, but the majority sentiment expressed around the table was against putting more money into TCP (leaning toward demolition rather than roof repair), pending a formal committee vote at a future meeting.

entry.title: TC Passios: the site's future: Select Board, 2026-07-14
entry.summary: Plan a tour of municipal buildings (Town Hall, Ritter, public safety building, DPW, TCP, Brooks House) for select board members, likely timed for after the August election.

entry.title: TC Passios: the site's future: Town Meeting, 2026-05-02
entry.summary: Article 24: transfer $121,800 from free cash for TCP building operating/decommissioning costs and $27,500 from assessor's overlay surplus for a special assistant to the assessor — not audible (recording ends during discussion)

entry.title: TC Passios: the site's future: Finance Committee, 2026-04-02
entry.summary: Recommend approval of special appropriation for TC Pasios operating/decommissioning costs and assistant to the assessor position (M1) — passed

entry.title: TC Passios: the site's future: Select Board, 2026-03-31
entry.summary: Include and recommend approval of Article M1 (special appropriations for TC Pasio decommissioning and assessors' overlay transfer) — passed 5-0, unanimous

entry.title: TC Passios: the site's future: School Committee, 2026-02-25
entry.summary: Election Day will remain a day off in the FY26-27 school calendar in case TCP is decommissioned and voting moves into a school building.

entry.title: TC Passios: the site's future: Finance Committee, 2026-02-19
entry.summary: The town will fund TC Pacios building operations through FY27 while winding down user groups, with the goal of not heating it through another winter and a possible decommissioning warrant article next year.
